svg.text: Follow the error to the right component
Teaching diagram · not a screenshot or actual terminal result
Find the site ID and its log folder, normally C:\inetpub\logs\LogFiles\W3SVC<site-id>. Make one
failed request and match its timestamp, path, status and substatus.
For 404, check URL, physical path and index.php. For 403, check default document, authorization
and file permissions. For 500, check PHP configuration and logs; 500.19 often points to invalid
For 502.3, investigate FastCGI startup, runtime architecture and PHP errors. Recycle only this
pool after a fix. Do not disable all security or restart every website.
Check: You can match a real request to its IIS log record and a targeted next check.
